topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct and sanctions statement (POL-01 4.8); POL-05 acknowledged at hire and yearly
evidence: Code of conduct; acknowledgment report (91%); sanctions log

control_description: Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber risk and PCI DSS reports from the vCISO
gap: Quarterly reporting formalized only from 2026-09; one meeting on record
remediation: Hold and minute each quarterly report through the observation period

control_description: IT Director designated information security officer; vCISO, General Counsel, and system owners named; reporting lines in POL-01
Background checks for sensitive roles; yearly training; role-based training for administrators and finance
evidence: HR checklist sample (25 of 25); LMS report
gap: No role-based training for the retail media team on supplier data confidentiality; store staff refresher missing (POAM-004)
remediation: Retail media confidentiality module; store module

control_description: Control owners named in the SSP and POA&M; performance goals for directors include security metrics
Inventories and data flow maps for the supplier offers service
gap: Supplier data flows (offers engine, warehouse, portal) not documented end to end
remediation: Data flow map for the service (POL-04 4.7)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies published on the intranet; acknowledgments; security reminders
Supplier agreements describe the service; supplier support contact
gap: No security commitments or system description for suppliers; no channel for suppliers to report incidents
remediation: Security schedule in supplier agreements; system description draft

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives for the service (accurate redemptions, timely reports, supplier data separation) set in the P01 appetite statements
SP 800-30 risk assessment covering the service (P01 R-005, R-031, R-032)
Fraud risks considered in P01 (refund and gift card fraud, payment diversion)
gap: Coupon redemption fraud (counterfeit or duplicate digital offers) not assessed
remediation: Add redemption fraud scenarios and controls

control_description: Change-driven risk review
gap: The December 2025 cloud move and the supplier data pilot did not trigger a risk review
remediation: Risk review step in the change and data sharing processes (POL-01 4.15)

control_description: Annual co-sourced internal audit (P07); separate QSA assessment; monthly posture reviews
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported quarterly

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 Moderate baseline and P01 risks (SSP)
General IT controls over the cloud workloads, identity, and change
gap: No configuration baselines (STD-01 pending)
remediation: Issue STD-01 with cloud workload baselines (POAM-006)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-15; standards index
gap: Six standards still in draft
remediation: Issue the standards on the schedule in the standards index

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Identity provider with MFA; role-based access in the warehouse and portal; encryption at rest
evidence: Identity provider policy; role exports; encryption settings
gap: Portal row-level separation tested only at launch; loyalty API keys not rotated since 2025
remediation: Portal penetration test; key rotation (POAM-003)

control_description: Workforce accounts from the HR feed; supplier portal users added by the retail media team
evidence: Identity provider provisioning logs; portal user list
gap: Supplier portal users added without documented approval from the supplier's named administrator
remediation: Supplier-side approval and quarterly supplier user review

control_description: Role-based access with reviews
gap: Reviews semiannual; agency excess rights; shared analyst account runs the weekly agency export (P07 AC-2, AC-6)
remediation: Quarterly reviews; named service identity for exports (POAM-001, POAM-003)

control_description: Cloud data centers inherited from the cloud provider; support center badge access
Disposal of data and media
gap: Agency copies of member exports never deleted; no supplier data disposal at contract end
remediation: Deletion terms and certificates of deletion (POAM-018)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Cloud hub firewall, deny by default, web application firewall in front of the portal, MFA for remote access
gap: No penetration test of the supplier reporting portal
remediation: Application penetration test (P01 R-032)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: Restrictions on data movement
gap: Member-level exports leave by email; hashed emails were shared with a supplier without approval
remediation: Governed transfer; supplier pilot paused 2026-09-01; data sharing review (POAM-018, POAM-022)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on cloud workloads and PCs with 24x7 MSSP; users cannot install software

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Monthly cloud vulnerability scans; posture service
gap: Portal application not tested; POS head-office instances excluded from scans
remediation: Portal testing; include all instances (POAM-011)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: SIEM monitoring of identity, cloud, and firewall events by the MSSP
gap: No egress alerting on the loyalty subnet or warehouse
remediation: Egress alerts (POAM-016)

control_description: MSSP triage; incident queue with severity and discovery time
Incident response policy and runbooks (P08)
gap: Runbooks approved 2026-09-15 but not yet exercised; supplier notice step new
remediation: Tabletop exercises (POAM-010)

control_description: Recovery from incidents
gap: Loyalty and CDP database, warehouse, and portal never restore-tested
remediation: Quarterly restore tests (POAM-008)

control_description: Change board for integration and infrastructure changes
gap: Portal code changes not reviewed; offers engine configuration changes made by the business without tickets
remediation: Code review and change tickets for portal and offers engine changes

control_description: Business disruption planning from the BIA
gap: No contingency plan for the cloud workloads that run the service
remediation: Contingency plan (POAM-008)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor and business partner risk management
gap: Offers engine vendor has no data use or security terms; TPSP and vendor program incomplete
remediation: STD-03; vendor terms (POAM-012, POAM-023)

control_description: Capacity monitoring and autoscaling for the portal and warehouse
Immutable backups in a second region; provider redundancy
Recovery plan testing
gap: No restore test of the warehouse, CDP, or portal
remediation: Quarterly restore tests (POAM-008)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Supplier campaign and sales data classified Confidential (POL-04 4.1); per-supplier separation
gap: Separation between suppliers tested only at launch
remediation: Annual separation test (POL-04 4.12)

control_description: Disposal of confidential supplier data
gap: No disposal step at the end of a supplier agreement
remediation: Disposal and certificate step in the offboarding checklist

control_description: Processing objectives for offers and redemptions
gap: Accuracy objectives (for example redemption match rate) not documented
remediation: Document processing objectives and tolerances

control_description: Inputs: register redemption records and offers engine campaign settings
gap: Campaign settings entered by hand with no second check; register inputs not validated against active campaigns
remediation: Second-person check for campaign setup; input validation rules

control_description: Processing of redemptions into supplier billing
gap: No reconciliation between register redemptions, warehouse totals, and supplier invoices (P01 R-031)
remediation: Automated daily reconciliation with exception reports

control_description: Outputs: supplier reports and invoices
gap: Reports reviewed by spot check only
remediation: Exception review before reports and invoices are released

control_description: Stored campaign and redemption data protected and backed up
